replies.text:
@Tamers12345MLP  I've been around since "Rainbow Dash's Birthday Bash." I want to say thank you for making the stallion content. I'm on a rewatch and have been skipping the Sorin/Breburn stuff bc the hitting scene legit sends me into a depression (that's a compliment). This series has made me want to make my own things that aren't ready for the limelight yet and broaden my horizons with what I consume. I wait every 14 days for you to cheer me up, and you always do without fail.

I love that your ethos is making wth you want, even the "low effort" frames are masterclasses in comedic timing. I still remember "Twilight, call your dad, I want to f him, shining armor, call your dad." And will giggle to myself about it sometimes. 

I think with everyone my age, life is this never ending balancing act of unsatisfying and distrustful relationships, working your ass off, and then doing it again the next day. It's nice to see such a human and honest recreation of what life feels like as a g*y person trying to start my life, made very obviously from someone who can make "homop*bic f*ish content" and still very obviously come from a place of understanding, love, and experience.

I cry to your sh*t more than stuff that costs infinitely more to make. You are an inspiration, funny pony fart man. 

If you need help making stuff I've been working on becoming better with voice work and would love to help!

Thank you, Tamers12345 <3

text: I liked this overall, I do feel one of the strengths for this episode is that there were so many different plot points happening at once that the conversations felt well paced out. I've been interested especially in Friendship and Arinos and their arc this episode was engaging. My only real criticism of this episode would be that it felt uncharacteristically lacking in humor. I wanna make it clear, I very much love how serious of a story teller you are, but one of my favorite aspects of that has been your ability to often use jokes that are then intertwined with that serious narrative. That's a skill i see almost nowhere and that I love about your writing. I firmly believe that the humor has never undermined the serious notes, even if some might disagree. I think the humor has always elevated the emotional storytelling, made the characters more multifaceted, and the juxtaposition of the jokes and plot makes those serious moments hit a lot harder. I love that rollercoaster of laughing and suddenly feeling real emotion and then laughing and so on. I value that a lot and see it consistently in virtually every prior episode so I wish I had more of that experience this episode.
author: @GhostCatAllan

replies.text:
Thanks! I really tried to make so that every character's wish followed a certain theme of them trying to fix themselves so that nobody who the story was focusing on at any time, they were all kinda searching for the same thing. And of course all of them ultimately getting what they wanted without relying on an outside source like the Kirin's wish to give it to them. 

The lack of jokes was intentional on my part and because I specifically wanted to make an episode that felt slightly different from my other ones and stands on its own away from all the other episodes. Like if somebody is binging all my episodes a year from now and they get to this episode I want them to be like "Oh that was slightly different, okay." The next mlp episode will have a lot of humor like before, I just like being experimental from time to time.
replies.author: @Tamers12345MLP

replies.text: ​@Tamers12345MLP I greatly appreciate hearing your insight into that creative process. I did notice that theme of self-actualization during their journeys. I of course am happy to hear how intentional it is and that the humor isn't going anywhere, but seeing the context you're giving the episode, it is very climactic for all these characters and I can understand your decision to ensure that it stands out as an important piece of the timeline. I think when i inevitably binge watch them again sometime (tomorrow) that feeling will make more sense as a part of a greater whole. I love your writing and that approach to growth and experimentation.

text:
I know it says "To be continued" and I want it to be continued, but this feels like it could be a true, "show-cancelled", ending for the stallions. Like, they are way-to-prepared to just live in this alternate universe with no real ponies. I guess they can repopulate the planet with more mpreg magic? Though such ponies would be future ponies whose blood would be taken by Parselcore. 

Also, when Parselcore makes his 9-part wish, does that not actually happen but transfer them to the wish world? so in general, while minor wishes or those that can be resolved via universe travel (eg Clean Sweep's wish) work, most of their wishes would actually just create a duplicate virtual world. So maybe, for example, Kirin's wish (assuming he's not lying about it -- I find it hard to believe that he really wants to change, at least not in such a simple way) would just send them to a separate wish dimensions where everything is the same except a duplicate of Clean Sweep who forgives him, while the original lives in the real world -- maybe it sends them to a wish dimension where Kirin actively earns Clean Sweep's forgiveness, and then they seamlessly return back to the normal world?

text:
Ahh.. god, I can’t just scroll past and not say anything. This episode literally filled in the missing puzzle pieces for me to finally get the full picture, and I’m absolutely losing it.
I only started watching this MLP project recently, and I actually found you through your Dandy’s World animations at first. But ngl, I was sleeping on this for way too long, ’cause now my hyperfixation is literally built around your pony show. No, for real thank you so much, I did NOT expect this to hit me this hard in the feels..
It sucks that not all the episodes are still up on your main channel, but I managed to find an archive with the whole series, so now I’m fully caught up on all the lore. And honestly? It’s hilariously ironic that this whole insane plot started because of a Sonic Underground collab, lmaoo..
I’m absolutely in love with your storytelling, your art style, the way you tackle deep psychological themes, and your straight-up unhinged humor. I definitely have my faves now, but also some characters I’m side-eyeing hard (looking at you, you hypocritical Big Mac..).
Just wanna say a huge thanks again for all the effort you’re putting into this project. I really hope it blows up even more in the future, ’cause you absolutely deserve it!! <3
